Generate documentation from the project's `##` blocks.

Renders a markdown reference from the literate structure of the entry file: `## To` signatures, type definitions, notes, examples, and formal blocks — in source order. `## Main` is omitted.

Usage: largo doc [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --out <OUT>
          Output directory (defaults to `target/doc`)

  -q, --quiet
          Suppress informational output (errors still print)

  -v, --verbose...
          Increase output verbosity (repeatable)

      --color <WHEN>
          When to use terminal colors

          Possible values:
          - auto:   Color when stdout/stderr is a terminal and `NO_COLOR` is unset
          - always: Always emit ANSI, even into pipes (CI logs, `less -R`)
          - never:  Never emit ANSI
          
          [default: auto]

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

Examples:
  largo doc
  largo doc --out book
